verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a dedicated sandbox at demo.ramp.com with API base demo-api.ramp.com, built so developers can test 'without affecting live production data' and with 'no real money movement.' It also offers a demo actions panel (⌘ J) for simulating events such as adding transactions or paying bills. The agent tooling targets it directly: the CLI connects to Sandbox by default, and Ramp MCP has a demo endpoint at demo-mcp.ramp.com. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox and demo MCP/CLI flows work as documented.
